summary: Built Phase 0.3 (oauth-lifecycle.js) and Phase 0.4 (security-isolation.js) black-box acceptance harnesses with shared helpers (lib.js), mock test hooks for negative token/grant cases, and self-contained verify scripts. All four Phase 0 harnesses (0.1-0.4) are intentionally red against current production behavior and green against the compliant mock.
follow_up: The harnesses are intentionally red against the current production component; they will turn green when Phases 2-6 of the fix plan are implemented.

The S9 concurrency-isolation test uses two different subjects (sub=1, sub=2) via the mock's token-mint hook; a real production component would need two independently authenticated clients with different grants.
important_context: The mock server (mock/lifecycle-server.js) is driven by MOCK_WORLD (compliant|current) and has verification-only test hooks (/_test/token/mint, /_test/grant/*) for driving negative cases.
The harnesses are pure HTTP clients; they do not launch the slice1-lab binaries or treat the lab binary as a release artifact.
Phase 0.3/0.4 harnesses use lib.js for shared OAuth flow, MCP calls, and JWT helpers.
